description: 两件看似矛盾的事情同时成立
bad_output_patterns: only states the contradiction without resolving it
uses paradox as decoration rather than discovery
sounds philosophical without grounding in observation
good_output_patterns: shows two opposing truths holding simultaneously in one concrete moment
reveals that what seemed like a problem is also its own solution
grounds the paradox in a specific observable thing
changes how the reader understands the relationship between two opposites
